groups.note_en: Six checks aimed at one site or host name.
groups.note_zh: 针对某个网站或域名的六项检查。

groups.note_en: Five checks about the quality of the path itself.
groups.note_zh: 关于线路本身质量的五项检查。

groups.note_en: TCP handshakes and bounded HTTP responses.
groups.note_zh: TCP 握手与有界 HTTP 响应。
按需读取快照，不常驻监控。

en.name: Website check
en.short: DNS, HTTPS, HTTP and the route one request really took.
en.checks: Resolves the name with both the system and the core, requests the site over HTTPS and HTTP through the local proxy, and reports which protocol answered and the policy chain the request actually used.
en.when: Start here when a site will not open and you do not yet know which layer is at fault.
en.note: An HTTP 403 or 500 proves that something answered, not that the service works. Redirects are reported, not followed. You may leave out the scheme.

zh.name: 网站检查
zh.short: 解析、HTTPS、HTTP，以及这次请求实际走的线路。
zh.checks: 分别用系统和内核解析域名，经本机代理用 HTTPS 和 HTTP 各请求一次，报告哪种协议得到了响应，以及这次请求实际经过的策略链。
zh.when: 网站打不开，又不知道问题出在哪一层时，先从这里查。
zh.note: HTTP 403、500 只说明对方有响应，不说明服务可用。重定向只报告，不会跟着跳转。输入时可以省略协议。

en.name: DNS comparison
en.short: The system resolver and the core, side by side.
en.checks: Resolves one host name with the system resolver and with the core, and shows both answers next to each other.
en.when: A site opens in one app but not in another, or you suspect a wrong or hijacked answer.
en.note: Different answers are not a fault on their own. The controller query returns real upstream addresses even with Fake-IP. Version 0.7.2-fix.4 adds record types, TTL and available AA/RA flags; TXT/SOA bodies are hidden.

zh.name: DNS 对照
zh.short: 系统解析和内核解析，并排比较。
zh.checks: 同一个域名分别交给系统解析器和内核解析，把两边的结果并排列出。
zh.when: 同一个网站在这个应用能开、另一个应用打不开，或者怀疑解析结果被污染、被劫持时。
zh.note: 两边结果不同，本身不算故障。内核控制查询在 Fake-IP 下仍返回真实上游地址。0.7.2-fix.4 起可选记录类型，查看 TTL 和返回的 AA/RA 标志；TXT/SOA 正文隐藏。

en.name: Connection timing
en.short: How long DNS, the proxy hop, TCP, TLS and the first byte each take.
en.checks: Times one connection stage by stage: core DNS, the local SOCKS5 hop, TCP to the target, the TLS handshake and the first byte of the response.
en.when: A site loads, but slowly, and you want to know which stage eats the time.
en.note: Each stage is measured on its own, so one slow step stands out instead of hiding in a total.

zh.name: 连接耗时
zh.short: 解析、代理、TCP、TLS、首字节，各花了多久。
zh.checks: 把一次连接拆成几段分别计时：内核 DNS、本机 SOCKS5、到目标的 TCP、TLS 握手，以及响应的首字节。
zh.when: 网站能打开，但是慢，想知道时间耗在哪一段。
zh.note: 各阶段独立计时，慢的那一步会单独显出来，不会被总耗时掩盖。

en.name: IPv4 / IPv6
en.checks: Connects to the target once over IPv4 and once over IPv6, each through the local proxy.
en.when: Something works on one network and fails on another, or you are deciding whether to keep IPv6 switched on.
en.note: A host with no AAAA record is reported as having no IPv6 address. It is not counted as a failed connection.

zh.name: IPv4 / IPv6
zh.checks: 经本机代理，分别用 IPv4 和 IPv6 地址各连接目标一次。
zh.when: 换个网络就连不上，或者在犹豫要不要保持 IPv6 开启时。
zh.note: 域名没有 AAAA 记录时，会如实说明没有 IPv6 地址，不会算成连接失败。

en.name: Rule and exit
en.short: Which rule matched, and which node the request left through.
en.checks: Sends a real request, then reads back the rule it matched and the full policy chain it travelled.
en.when: Traffic leaves through an exit you did not expect, or a rule you wrote does not seem to apply.
en.note: The answer comes from this request. It is not a guess based on whichever node is selected at the moment.

zh.name: 规则与出口
zh.short: 命中了哪条规则，从哪个节点出去。
zh.checks: 发出一次真实请求，再查出它命中的规则和走过的完整策略链。
zh.when: 流量从意料之外的出口出去，或者自己写的规则好像没有生效时。
zh.note: 结果来自这一次请求本身，不是拿当前选中的节点来推测。

en.name: TLS certificate
en.short: Host name, validity, trust chain and fingerprint.
en.checks: Verifies the certificate's host name, validity period and trust chain, and shows a short summary of the certificate.
en.when: A browser shows a certificate warning, or you suspect something on the path is intercepting HTTPS.
en.note: Always uses HTTPS and never skips verification. Only a limited set of certificate fields is shown.

zh.name: TLS 证书
zh.short: 域名、有效期、信任链和证书摘要。
zh.checks: 验证证书的域名、有效期和信任链，并显示证书摘要。
zh.when: 浏览器提示证书有问题，或者怀疑线路上有人拦截 HTTPS 时。
zh.note: 始终使用 HTTPS，不会绕过验证。证书只展示有限的几个字段。

en.name: Short stability run
en.short: A handful of requests, with failures and the spread of response times.
en.checks: Sends a limited number of requests and reports how many failed and how the response-header times were spread.
en.when: A connection works, drops, then works again.
en.note: The whole run is capped at 120 seconds. If count, interval and time limit add up to more, you get the results collected so far, marked as timed out.

zh.name: 短时稳定性
zh.short: 连续请求几次，看失败数和耗时分布。
zh.checks: 发送有限次数的请求，报告失败了几次，以及响应头耗时的分布。
zh.when: 连接时好时坏、断断续续时。
zh.note: 整轮检查最多 120 秒。次数、间隔和时限加起来超过时，返回已经取得的结果，并明确标为超时。

en.name: UDP reachability
en.short: A DNS probe through the proxy's UDP relay.
en.checks: Sends one DNS probe to the server through the local SOCKS5 UDP relay. Port 53 is used unless you give another.
en.when: Calls, games or QUIC fail although ordinary web pages load.
en.note: Nothing is sent when UDP is switched off in settings, or while Claude protection is on.

zh.name: UDP 连通
zh.short: 经代理的 UDP 中继发一个 DNS 探针。
zh.checks: 经本机 SOCKS5 的 UDP 中继，向服务器发送一个 DNS 探针。不写端口时用 53。
zh.when: 网页正常，但语音通话、游戏或 QUIC 不通时。
zh.note: 在设置里关闭了 UDP，或者 Claude 保护开启时，不会发送探针。

en.name: Ping
en.checks: Runs the system's ICMP ping against the host.
en.when: You want to know whether the host answers at all from this machine.
en.note: This is not the latency of a proxy node. System ping does not use the HTTP proxy, and whether TUN carries it depends on your routes. It is never imitated with TCP.

zh.name: Ping
zh.checks: 调用系统的 ICMP ping 探测目标主机。
zh.when: 想知道从这台机器出发，对方到底有没有回应时。
zh.note: 它不代表代理节点的延迟。系统 Ping 不走 HTTP 代理，是否被 TUN 接管取决于路由。工具不会用 TCP 冒充 ICMP。

en.name: Route trace
en.short: Hop-by-hop replies from the system tracer.
en.checks: Runs the system's route tracer and lists the hops that answered.
en.when: You want to see where along the path the replies stop.
en.note: A hop that stays silent does not mean the path is broken. Android often ships without traceroute; the tool then says it is unavailable.

zh.name: 路由追踪
zh.short: 系统追踪工具的逐跳响应。
zh.checks: 调用系统的路由追踪，列出有回应的每一跳。
zh.when: 想看回应是在路径的哪一段消失时。
zh.note: 某一跳不回应，不等于线路断了。Android 系统常常没有 traceroute，这时工具会明确提示不可用。

en.name: Capped download
en.short: Receives a limited amount of data and throws it away.
en.checks: Downloads from the URL until a time or size cap is reached, and discards the body as it arrives.
en.when: Pages open, but large files crawl or stall.
en.note: The server must answer with a success status. Reaching the cap is normal and does not count as a failure.

zh.name: 限量下载
zh.short: 限时限流量地接收一段数据，收到即丢。
zh.checks: 从目标地址下载，直到达到时间或流量上限；正文边收边丢，不保存。
zh.when: 网页能开，但大文件下载很慢或者中途卡住时。
zh.note: 需要服务器返回成功状态。正常达到上限不算失败。

en.name: TCP port
en.checks: Times the local SOCKS5 hop and the target handshake.
en.note: Requires 0.7.2-fix.4. Uses the current proxy; default port 443. A handshake does not prove TLS or service health.

zh.name: TCP 端口
zh.short: 只握手，不发送应用数据。
zh.checks: 计时本机 SOCKS5 和目标端口连接。
zh.when: 怀疑服务端口无法访问时。
zh.note: 0.7.2-fix.4 起提供。沿用当前代理，默认端口 443；握手成功不代表 TLS 或服务正常。

en.name: HTTP response
en.short: Status, safe headers and bounded body size.
en.checks: Sends HEAD, GET or OPTIONS; reads at most 4 KiB of body and discards it.
en.when: A site answers but behaves unexpectedly.
en.note: Requires 0.7.2-fix.4. No redirect following. Cookies, authorization headers and body text are not retained.

zh.name: HTTP 响应详情
zh.short: 状态、受限响应头与正文长度。
zh.checks: 发送 HEAD、GET 或 OPTIONS，最多接收 4 KiB 正文并丢弃。
zh.when: 网站有响应但行为异常时。
zh.note: 0.7.2-fix.4 起提供。不跟随重定向，不保留 Cookie、认证头和正文。

en.name: Rule preview
en.short: An offline estimate, with uncertainty shown.
en.checks: Reads the last generated configuration and stops at the first condition it cannot evaluate.
en.when: Checking simple domain, IP or port rules without contacting a target.
en.note: Requires 0.7.2-fix.4. Dynamic rules, Geo and process conditions remain unknown. Use Rule and exit for a real request.

zh.name: 规则预判
zh.short: 离线判断，无法确认时明确说明。
zh.checks: 读取最后生成的配置，遇到无法判断的条件立即停止。
zh.when: 不连接目标，检查简单域名、IP 或端口规则时。
zh.note: 0.7.2-fix.4 起提供。动态规则、Geo 和进程条件保持未知；实际线路使用“规则与出口”。

en.name: Configuration diff
en.checks: Compares field types, item counts and whether selected sections changed.
en.when: Understanding which settings overrode a subscription.
en.note: Requires 0.7.2-fix.4. A disk snapshot, not proof of live state. Values, node addresses, DNS servers and credentials are hidden.

zh.name: 配置差异
zh.short: 原订阅与生成配置摘要。
zh.checks: 比较字段类型、条目数和所选配置块是否变化。
zh.when: 想知道哪些设置覆盖了订阅时。
zh.note: 0.7.2-fix.4 起提供。磁盘快照不代表实时状态；不显示节点地址、DNS 上游或凭据。

en.name: Traffic breakdown
en.checks: Groups by host, process, policy chain and rule type; shows eight groups per category.
en.when: Identifying which active connections account for traffic.
en.note: Requires 0.7.2-fix.4. No history; totals cover live connections only. Process details depend on the core and OS.

zh.name: 流量分解
zh.short: 四种分组查看当前连接。
zh.checks: 按主机、进程、策略链和规则类型汇总，每类显示八组。
zh.when: 查看哪些活跃连接占用了流量时。
zh.note: 0.7.2-fix.4 起提供。不留历史，仅统计仍在内核中的连接；进程信息取决于系统和内核。

en.name: Core runtime
en.checks: Reads one bounded sample, then closes the metrics stream.
en.when: Checking the core without starting a background monitor.
en.note: Requires 0.7.2-fix.4. Managed heap is not process RSS. Missing metrics are reported, never estimated.

zh.name: 内核运行
zh.checks: 读取一次有界样本后关闭指标流。
zh.when: 不启动常驻监控，查看内核情况时。
zh.note: 0.7.2-fix.4 起提供。托管堆不是 RSS；未提供的指标不推算。

en.name: Node runtime
en.checks: Looks up a full node name, its last delay and selected policy path without retesting.
en.when: Understanding an automatic or nested group.
en.note: Requires 0.7.2-fix.4. Names with spaces or emoji must be quoted in CLI. Past delay does not prove current health.

zh.name: 节点运行详情
zh.short: 类型、所属组与当前选择。
zh.checks: 按完整名称查看最近延迟和策略链，不主动测速。
zh.when: 查看自动组或多层策略组时。
zh.note: 0.7.2-fix.4 起提供。CLI 中带空格或 emoji 的名称须加引号；历史延迟不代表现在可达。

seconds.en: Time limit for one attempt, in seconds

bytes.en: Download cap in bytes (8 MiB by default; the window takes whole MiB)
bytes.zh: 下载上限，字节（默认 8 MiB，界面里按整数 MiB 输入）

type.range: ADDR / A / AAAA / CNAME / MX / TXT / NS / SOA / PTR / CAA
type.en: Core DNS record type; system comparison still uses A/AAAA
type.zh: 内核 DNS 记录类型，系统对照仍查询 A/AAAA

symptoms.en: Traffic leaves through the wrong exit

symptoms.zh: 通话、游戏或 QUIC 不通

symptoms.en: Trouble only on IPv6, or only on IPv4
symptoms.zh: 只有 IPv6 或只有 IPv4 出问题

symptoms.en: Not sure the host answers at all
symptoms.zh: 不确定对方有没有回应
